question: Where’s the closest restaurant lying along the route toward Mary Prentiss Inn, Cambridge, MA from Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cyrus Dallin Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Arlington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mary Prentiss Inn%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cambridge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), route_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(o.geometry, d.geometry) AS geom FROM origin AS o, destination AS d ), buffered_route AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 100) AS geom -- 100 meters buffer to define "along the route" FROM route_segment ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, origin AS o, buffered_route AS br WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, br.geom::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
